notes:
## New features
- **Calculate every scenario and time slice in one go.** The Contours Result page now shows a grid with one tile per scenario and time slice. Teal is the result on screen, white tiles are calculated, amber means the inputs have changed since, and empty tiles are not calculated yet. Click any tile to show that result. The Calculate button's second half is now **All**: every scenario and time slice, all time slices of this scenario, all scenarios for this time slice, or all views. Hover a choice to see which tiles it covers. During the run the tiles fill as they're calculated and the grid counts down ("Calculating 3 of 4 · about 2 min left"), then AURIS returns to the result you started on. Each scenario's results are saved, so they're all there when you reopen the project.
- **Interpolated contours keep fading shadow edges sharp.** Where a building's acoustic shadow fades out partway across an area, the level step along its edge no longer blends into neighbouring grid cells: each side takes its values from its own receivers, and beyond the point where the step fades, the field joins up smoothly again. Checked against 2,500 exact calculations on P1995, the field near these edges is closer to the true levels: average error 0.12 → 0.10 dB, and 90% of points within 0.20 dB (was 0.30 dB). Elsewhere it is unchanged.

## Changes
- **The SmartSmooth curve-smoothing slider now does what it says.** At 25%, 50% and 100% the curves follow the calculated contour progressively more loosely, within the same accuracy limits. Before, all three settings drew almost the same lines.
- **Faster contour meshing.** The step that joins neighbouring cells of the contour mesh runs about twice as fast with identical results (P1995: 24 s → 12 s of contour preparation).

## Bug fixes
- **Switching scenario could mark another scenario's contours as out of date.** After calculating one scenario's Day and then another's, going back showed "Inputs have changed since this result". Each scenario now keeps its own record.
- After switching time slice, the Grid note could say the displayed contour was stale and name the previous slice.
- **Calculating contours on a model without sources** showed a technical failure ("Nonfinite exact propagation-region support"). AURIS now says the model has no sources yet and that one is needed.
